title: 菲兹·海崖静望
description: 蓝色鱼人菲兹保留水生头形、耳鳍与蹼足，在宽海岸平台静持三叉戟，海面与侧光构成开阔景深。

art_direction.medium: angular wax-crayon strokes, directional hatching and dramatic hard-edged light on textured paper
art_direction.identity: Fizz is a small amphibious yordle with smooth blue skin, a broad aquatic head, large golden eyes, fin-like ears, webbed hands and feet, and a compact nonhuman body. Preserve his natural species proportions without enlarging the head into a mascot or turning him into a human child. His characteristic waist garment is opaque, and his long three-pronged trident rests upright at his side.
art_direction.scene: Place him still on a broad low coastal stone platform with both webbed feet grounded and one hand holding the vertical trident comfortably. The weapon points only upward into empty space, never toward a target. Hard sea light defines angular blue wax-crayon facets, while a distant lighthouse silhouette, calm water, and enormous clear sky create a dignified adventurous image.
art_direction.palette: deep turquoise, golden eyes, slate sea, warm sand
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
